title: Phase-E replay: 3117 of 5154 live rows exact through current OxFunc
status_plain: This is the only production-OxFunc-versus-live-Excel measurement that covers PMT, IPMT, PPMT, CUMIPMT, CUMPRINC, FV and PV on one corpus under one predicate. OxFunc publishes only the aggregate: 3117 of 5154 rows exact, 1318 at 1 ULP, 542 at 2-16 ULP and 177 above 16 ULP. Two OxFunc documents state it consistently, one merging the last two buckets as "719 above". The words "through current OxFunc" are what make it a production figure rather than a research-model one; the 5,319-row corpus in the annuity spec is the research corpus and is a different object. The aggregate is 60.4773 per cent. It is a GROUP total over ten surfaces and it must never be attributed to PMT, which is 4,040 of the 5,154 rows. The per-surface split is not published in any OxFunc sentence; it is recomputed in EV-FIN-0002 and carries the disclosure that recomputation demands. The corpus also contains 30 POWER rows and 17 PDURATION rows, so the denominators only reconcile across all ten surfaces.
